title: Part 2 Expansion Readiness Scorecard

blocking_dimensions.root_cause: 0 Evaluate items, 10 Analyze items, 0 Very Difficult items. Cognitive distribution unrepresentative of actual CMA exam.
blocking_dimensions.resolution: S833 Sprints 1-4 (~300 hours, 12-16 weeks) — recalibration + 740 new content items

blocking_dimensions.root_cause: Template-rotation bulk generation is the only authoring mechanism. Produced 8 defect classes across 2,540 items.
blocking_dimensions.resolution: Validate quality-first pipeline on 50 Part 1 Analyze/Evaluate items (3 weeks, zero structural defects at first scan)

non_blocking_dimensions.note: 32/32 guard PASS, 6 rules, 36 defect library entries. Battle-tested across 2,540 items.
Admin, investigation, file management all scalable. String-aware parser, identity validator, governance guard all pack-agnostic.
Can remediate at scale (539 DL-008, 275 DL-017). Cannot yet author at quality. Lessons from Part 1 defects must inform Part 2 pipeline design.

critical_asymmetry: Governance (95) and Infrastructure (85) can validate and protect — but they cannot create content. Expanding Part 2 through the existing template-rotation pipeline would inject DL-008/013/026/031 into ~500 new items, requiring the same multi-year remediation Part 1 is still undergoing.

recommended_path.action: Validate quality-first authoring pipeline on 50 Part 1 Analyze items
Begin Part 2 blueprint analysis and content specification
Begin Part 2 content creation using validated pipeline

earliest_part2_start: ~14 weeks from decision (assuming sequential execution of phases 1-4)
part2_greenlight_criteria: Quality-first authoring pipeline validated (50 items, zero structural defects at first scan)
Part 1 difficulty within 10pp of CAQS targets on all bands
Part 1 Bloom's within 10pp of CAQS targets on all levels
Content authoring pipeline documented and repeatable
Part 2 foundation documents: FORMULA_MASTER.md, TAXONOMY_REGISTRY.md, decision trees, exam traps extended
part2_specific_infrastructure_gaps: FORMULA_MASTER.md has 34 Part 1 formulas — needs 20+ Part 2 formulas (NPV, IRR, WACC, CAPM, etc.)
No Part 2-specific common exam traps or accounting decision trees
Part 2 QID namespace (P2-A-001) not yet defined
Part 2 psychometric targets not yet calibrated (Part 2 has heavier Analyze/Evaluate emphasis)
